text: Implement typed explicit response-support policy at native design/model/workflow boundary with retained-scan selection. Distinguish unsupported events from partial computational windows; select or reject under explicit policy, retaining source row/run/condition receipts and counts. Apply any event removal before selection-dependent centering, missing-value handling and modulation transforms; never drop rows after fitting or alter source tables. Bind actual resolved shared/per-event/per-cell HRFs and retained samples through recorded recipes. Unit-input potential is counterfactual, not condition membership: derive matching cells from typed factor codes/CellKey rather than labels or nonzero modulator amplitudes. Handle zero modulators, no retained scans, negative/late events, FIR lag coverage, per-run boundaries, and selection-dependent level/basis changes without circular guessing. Test a centering counterexample where excluding a late event changes retained estimates; preserve source identity/fingerprint and expose native first-level APIs. Default absence of policy must not silently admit unsupported events in the consumer. Verify JVM/JS plus BIDS beta/FIR consumer, then wire app persisted policy and detailed review under plsneuro bd-01M1VKM2RSV5DZ56FEN7CK2WCA.
